rationale: The assistant went straight to the most likely and simplest cause (blocked filter/sump) and the customer confirmed the fix, with no parts or fabrication. However it never clarified what '24' meant (model vs E:24 code) as the ground truth expected, and it asked the customer to reach into the sump and turn the impeller by hand, mentioning 'glass' as possible debris, without advising switching off/unplugging or wearing gloves - a real omission given glass was present. Closing advice on filter maintenance was appropriate.
